name: Unlimit Group A/S
summary: Established in 2011 and based in Køge, Denmark, Unlimit Group A/S is a company focused on both creating and financially backing technology-driven ventures. Its core activities revolve around autonomous retail concepts, subscription-based economic frameworks, and strategic investments within the venture capital and power generation sectors. The entity presently known as Unlimit Group A/S was formerly Conferize A/S, changing its name in April 2025.
